summary: Iteration 2 — Frontend retest. Two new critical issues found. (1) /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx had a stray trailing fragment (`ureHandlerRootView>` + extra `);}`) that caused the entire web bundle to render BLANK (Babel/Metro error). FIXED by truncating to line 123. (2) Apply requirement screen still sends `email: ""` in POST /applications, which the backend rejects with HTTP 422 (Pydantic EmailStr — same root cause that broke onboarding in iteration 1). Onboarding-only strip-empties patch was not extended to /apply/requirement.tsx. (3) RootGate in _layout.tsx does not redirect a signed-in but not-yet-onboarded user from /auth/* to /onboarding, so brand-new users are stuck on the OTP screen even though /auth/otp/verify returned 200 — only a manual goto('/onboarding') unblocked them. Once the user is onboarded (subsequent logins), RootGate correctly redirects to /(tabs). All other flows verified end-to-end: /promise is public, EMI calculator, Bank Compare (6 cards + BEST VALUE), Welcome→Login→OTP, Onboarding submit (200), Home (15% hero, RM Call/WhatsApp, home-start-apply), Loans (8 loan-type-* cards), Apply requirement→documents→review→submit→success→status (after typing email to bypass bug 2), Status (8-stage vertical stepper, Submitted=Completed), Profile (user info, profile-rm-call/whatsapp, FAQ accordion, profile-sign-out). Deprecated shadow*/expo-notifications web-listener warnings still present.

critical.issue: Returns 422 when `email` field is an empty string. Detail: `value is not a valid email address: An email address must have an @-sign`. The frontend requirement.tsx spreads the form including `email: ''`, so any user who doesn't manually type an email gets blocked at the requirement screen. RCA: backend ApplicationCreate (or shared model) declares `email: Optional[EmailStr]` which Pydantic v2 rejects on empty string. Fix backend (`Optional[EmailStr]` → custom validator that returns None for empty) OR strip empties in /app/frontend/app/apply/requirement.tsx submit() like onboarding does.

ui_bugs.issue: File ended with stray fragment `ureHandlerRootView>\n  );\n}` (lines 124-126), causing a Babel parse error → blank web page on https://splendid-fintech.preview.emergentagent.com. Reference: /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx EOF. FIXED by testing agent — truncated file to 123 lines.

After a brand-new user verifies OTP successfully (POST /auth/otp/verify → 200, user has onboarded=false), the user stays stuck on /auth/otp. RootGate only redirects `inAuth → (tabs)` when user.onboarded is true; missing branch: `if (user && !user.onboarded && (inAuth || first === 'welcome' || first === '')) router.replace('/onboarding')`. Reference: /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx:66-72. Workaround during testing: manual goto('/onboarding').

Submit spreads `{...f}` including empty `email: ''`, triggering backend 422 (see backend critical). Reference: /app/frontend/app/apply/requirement.tsx:36-53. Fix: same empty-stripping logic that was applied to onboarding.tsx, OR fix backend EmailStr.

integration_issues.issue: OTP verify succeeds but user stuck on /auth/otp; needs RootGate fix OR a router.replace('/onboarding') inside otp.tsx after signInWithOtp resolves.
Blocked at POST /applications with 422 unless user manually fills email. Fix backend EmailStr OR frontend strip-empties.

issues: Input row overflows on 390px width; reduce gap or set explicit box width (~48px) so all 6 boxes fit within screen.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning `"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".` still emitted on every screen. Reference: across StyleSheet objects in /app/frontend/app/** and /app/frontend/src/components/**.

`[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web. Adding a listener will have no effect.` — guard listeners with `Platform.OS !== 'web'` in /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx.

action_items: FIX (CRITICAL): backend POST /applications — make `email` accept empty string/None. Either change to `Optional[str]` with @field_validator that coerces ''→None and regex-validates non-empty, OR add Pydantic BeforeValidator. Same pattern should be applied to ALL EmailStr fields in server.py to avoid future regressions.
FIX (CRITICAL): /app/frontend/app/apply/requirement.tsx submit() should strip empty/null/undefined fields before POST (mirror the fix already applied to /app/frontend/app/onboarding.tsx).

FIX (HIGH): /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx RootGate — add branch: `else if (!user.onboarded && (inAuth || first === 'welcome' || first === '')) router.replace('/onboarding')`. Without this, every brand-new user is stuck on /auth/otp after OTP verification despite a successful session token.
FIX (MEDIUM): /app/frontend/app/auth/otp.tsx — make OTP row responsive on 390px width (reduce gap, or set fixed small width per box).
FIX (LOW): replace deprecated `shadow*` style props with `boxShadow` / `elevation` across all StyleSheet objects.
FIX (LOW): guard expo-notifications listener registration in _layout.tsx with `Platform.OS !== 'web'`.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx had stale junk at EOF — indicates an unreviewed save/diff merge; add a lint pre-commit (tsc --noEmit) to catch.
Both /apply/requirement.tsx and /onboarding.tsx independently maintain an empty-stripping concern. Extract a shared `stripEmpties(obj)` util in /app/frontend/src/lib/ so future forms don't break.
Backend EmailStr usage is fragile across multiple endpoints — centralize via a custom `EmptyStrAsNoneEmail` type or a root validator on every model that accepts user-typed email.

rca_of_issue: Three RCAs: (1) Blank page — _layout.tsx EOF had `ureHandlerRootView>\n  );\n}` appended after the proper closing brace, causing Babel to throw. Fixed by truncating to 123 lines. (2) Apply 422 — backend Pydantic EmailStr on `email` field rejects empty string; frontend requirement.tsx sends `email: ''` because submit spreads the whole form state. (3) New-user stuck on /auth/otp — RootGate redirect table has no case for `signed-in AND !onboarded AND inAuth`; the existing onboarding nav only triggers when user navigates to /(tabs), but otp.tsx never pushes anywhere — it relies on RootGate alone.
